system.effectText: Poison (100%) Devil’s Puffball does double poison damage.
system.description: Poison (100%) Devil’s Puffball does double poison damage.

system.effectText: Negates the use of magic in this area for 20 rounds.
system.description: Negates the use of magic in this area for 20 rounds.

system.effectText: Creates a cloud of flammable gas that spreads in a randomly rolled direction for 3 turns before dissipating. If any fire is lit in this gas, it explodes. Everyone in it takes 5d6 damage and has an 75% chance of catching fire.
system.description: Creates a cloud of flammable gas that spreads in a randomly rolled direction for 3 turns before dissipating. If any fire is lit in this gas, it explodes. Everyone in it takes 5d6 damage and has an 75% chance of catching fire.

system.effectText: Anyone caught in the blast of this bomb must make a Stun save at -2 and is blinded for 6 rounds.
system.description: Anyone caught in the blast of this bomb must make a Stun save at -2 and is blinded for 6 rounds.

system.effectText: Any invisible or intangible creatures are made visible and tangible for 20 rounds. This also stops monsters from regenerating or transforming.
system.description: Any invisible or intangible creatures are made visible and tangible for 20 rounds. This also stops monsters from regenerating or transforming.

system.effectText: Any creature caught in the radius freezes in place until they make a DC:18 Physique check, until they are struck, or for 8 rounds. An attack on someone frozen does an extra 2d6 damage.
system.description: Any creature caught in the radius freezes in place until they make a DC:18 Physique check, until they are struck, or for 8 rounds. An attack on someone frozen does an extra 2d6 damage.

system.effectText: Anyone caught within the blast radius takes damage and has an 80% chance of sustaining a bleeding wound.
system.description: Anyone caught within the blast radius takes damage and has an 80% chance of sustaining a bleeding wound.

system.effectText: Any creature caught within the blast radius must make an Endurance roll with a DC of 18 or start fighting the closest person to them until a successful save is made.
system.description: Any creature caught within the blast radius must make an Endurance roll with a DC of 18 or start fighting the closest person to them until a successful save is made.

system.effectText: Covers those in the blast in a bright paint and a powerful odor that can be smelled from a mile away. The paint lasts for a full day and grants a +5 to spotting/ tracking the target.
system.description: Covers those in the blast in a bright paint and a powerful odor that can be smelled from a mile away. The paint lasts for a full day and grants a +5 to spotting/ tracking the target.

system.effectText: Any creature caught in this blast radius freezes in place until they make a DC:18 Physique check, until they are struck, or for 8 rounds. An attack on someone frozen does an extra 2d6 damage.

system.effectText: Explosive ammunition carries a small vial of highly reactive chemicals. When it strikes the target the vial breaks, causing an explosion that does 4d6 damage to every location of every person within 2m.
system.description: Explosive ammunition carries a small vial of highly reactive chemicals. When it strikes the target the vial breaks, causing an explosion that does 4d6 damage to every location of every person within 2m.

system.effectText: Split ammunition is made up of several bolts or arrows bound together. When fired, the binding breaks and the ammunition splits. For every point over a target’s defense you roll (maximum 3) you deal the weapon’s full damage to a random location.
system.description: Split ammunition is made up of several bolts or arrows bound together. When fired, the binding breaks and the ammunition splits. For every point over a target’s defense you roll (maximum 3) you deal the weapon’s full damage to a random location.

system.effectText: Tracking ammunition is soaked in a odorous solution which can easily be picked up by scent tracking. As long as it remains in the target, scent tracking requires no roll to follow their trail if it is less than half a day old.
